1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|a665cdb8.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

267328|3f01eec2.name: Norzsh
267328|3f01eec2.text: You think you got what it takes to mine ore?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

278680|fe2e6e48.name: Gabbi Goodwhistle
278680|fe2e6e48.text: What can I do for ya?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3143|e14f5e15.name: Gornek
3143|e14f5e15.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3184|c7dd471a.name: Miao'zan
3184|c7dd471a.text: You got the look of someone wantin' adventure. Me, I had enough of that by the time we trolls came here. Now I take each day as it comes, an' I train other folks to handle adventures for me.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3191|b48f927f.name: Cook Torka
3191|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5518|741f51fb.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|741f51fb.text: Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

786|55d7bbd7.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|55d7bbd7.text: Greetings, girl. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

7953|de02093f.name: Xar'Ti
7953|de02093f.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

1516-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-progress.text:
Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.

The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.

Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
1516-progress.title: Call of Earth

1518-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1518-progress.text:
I wish to be the first to welcome you fully to the first of four paths that will forever lead you in your destiny.

If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised.

If not, then be gone with you until you have found your way.
1518-progress.title: Call of Earth

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

2161-accept.name: Ukor
2161-accept.text:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!
2161-accept.title: A Peon's Burden

2161-complete.name: Innkeeper Grosk
2161-complete.text:
Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials.  Did they not need it?  Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training.  Builds spirit, they say!

Thank you for returning the food.  I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!

And don't forget to rest here in the inn.  You may be a brave $c ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.
2161-complete.title: A Peon's Burden

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

3084-progress.name: Shikrik
3084-progress.text: Ah, welcome, $N. I'm pleased you have arrived. My days have become long and even busy what with so many students to teach, but the coming of one of your ilk brings me a great sense of accomplishment--I remember the days when I was taught by one of your shamans.
3084-progress.title: Rune-Inscribed Tablet

3103-progress.name: Priestess Anetta
3103-progress.text: Ah, at last you've come. I knew you would find your way to me. The Holy Light shines upon you, and the path you've chosen. These times are harsh--the Burning Legion still has a presence upon Azeroth, the entirety of Kalimdor seeks new ways to defend itself from its own tribulations, and it is up to you to aid as many as you can.
3103-progress.title: Hallowed Letter

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-progress.name: Galgar
4402-progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402-progress.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4641-accept.name: Kaltunk
4641-accept.text:
Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
4641-accept.title: Your Place in the World

4641-complete.name: Gornek
4641-complete.text:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
4641-complete.title: Your Place in the World

5261-accept.name: Deputy Willem
5261-accept.text:
Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

If you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
5261-accept.title: Eagan Peltskinner

5441-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-accept.text:
Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.

Lousy slacking peons...
5441-accept.title: Lazy Peons

5441-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-complete.text: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
5441-complete.title: Lazy Peons

5441-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-progress.text:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
5441-progress.title: Lazy Peons

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5726-progress.name: Thrall
5726-progress.text:
Do you have the insignia yet, $N?

It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
5726-progress.title: Hidden Enemies

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

62-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
62-progress.text: What do you have to report, $N?  Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
62-progress.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6394-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-accept.text:
$N, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
6394-accept.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-complete.text: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $N.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
6394-complete.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-progress.text: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $N?  Did you find my pick?
6394-progress.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

7-accept.name: Marshal McBride
7-accept.text: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7-accept.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

783-accept.name: Deputy Willem
783-accept.text:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young $c, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
783-accept.title: A Threat Within

783-complete.name: Marshal McBride
783-complete.text:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The $r lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, $N.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.
783-complete.title: A Threat Within

784-accept.name: Gar'Thok
784-accept.text:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
784-accept.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

784-complete.name: Gar'Thok
784-complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
784-complete.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

786-accept.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-accept.text:
Lower your voice, $c. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
786-accept.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

788-accept.name: Gornek
788-accept.text:
The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
788-accept.title: Cutting Teeth

788-complete.name: Gornek
788-complete.text:
Hmmm, not bad, $N. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
788-complete.title: Cutting Teeth

789-accept.name: Gornek
789-accept.text:
Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.

The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...

But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
789-accept.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-complete.name: Gornek
789-complete.text:
There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

I have no more to teach you, $N. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
789-complete.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-progress.name: Gornek
789-progress.text: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
789-progress.title: Sting of the Scorpid

790-accept.name: Hana'zua
790-accept.text:
$C! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.

I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
790-accept.title: Sarkoth

790-complete.name: Hana'zua
790-complete.text: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
790-complete.title: Sarkoth

790-progress.name: Hana'zua
790-progress.text:
Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.

At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
790-progress.title: Sarkoth

791-accept.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-accept.text:
Age has rendered me useless in battle. Now I make myself useful in other ways.

From this vantage point I watch for invaders. As our strength here grows, I find myself blowing the signal horn less and less.

To pass the time I fashion goods to help younger, more able warriors defend our homeland.

For you, I can fashion you a bag for your belongings. If such an item would be of use to you, bring me some canvas, a material common to the humans and centaurs.
791-accept.title: Carry Your Weight

791-progress.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-progress.text:
I fought proudly alongside the Warchief when these lands were pioneered. The scars of battle mark my skin.

The honor of the Horde has been upheld with the help of my axe and battlecry during the defeat of Archimonde, when the unholy alliance was made with the humans and elves, wrought from necessity.

But my position as watchman and provider has given me a new sense of worth.
791-progress.title: Carry Your Weight

794-accept.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-accept.text:
Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.

It is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.

But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.

Go, $N.  You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
794-accept.title: Burning Blade Medallion

794-complete.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-complete.text:
You retrieved it!  Well done!

Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.

We have not seen the end of them.
794-complete.title: Burning Blade Medallion

794-progress.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-progress.text: Is your task complete, $N?  Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?
794-progress.title: Burning Blade Medallion

804-accept.name: Hana'zua
804-accept.text:
Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!

But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, $N, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
804-accept.title: Sarkoth

804-complete.name: Gornek
804-complete.text:
From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $N. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
804-complete.title: Sarkoth

805-accept.name: Zureetha Fargaze
805-accept.text:
Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.

Go to the $r village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.

Tell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.

Go, $N, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
805-accept.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

805-complete.name: Master Gadrin
805-complete.text:
Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.

The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.
805-complete.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

806-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-accept.text:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
806-accept.title: Dark Storms

806-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-progress.text: Did you find Fizzle, $N?  He, and rest of the Burning Blade, must be scoured from our lands!
806-progress.title: Dark Storms

808-accept.name: Master Gadrin
808-accept.text:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, $N. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!
808-accept.title: Minshina's Skull

815-accept.name: Cook Torka
815-accept.text:
Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

$N, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
815-accept.title: Break a Few Eggs

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

817-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-accept.text:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, $N. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
817-accept.title: Practical Prey

818-accept.name: Master Vornal
818-accept.text:
Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no $r or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.

Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

I need a few things. Will you get them for me?

I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
818-accept.title: A Solvent Spirit

818-progress.name: Master Vornal
818-progress.text: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
818-progress.title: A Solvent Spirit

823-accept.name: Master Gadrin
823-accept.text:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.
823-accept.title: Report to Orgnil

823-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
823-complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!
823-complete.title: Report to Orgnil

825-accept.name: Gar'Thok
825-accept.text:
One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

Swim through the wreckage, $N, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.
825-accept.title: From The Wreckage....

825-progress.name: Gar'Thok
825-progress.text:
Once we learn how the humans operate their strange machinery, we will stand a greater chance of defeating them in future battles.

With our new gained knowledge, the Horde only stands to grow in strength.
825-progress.title: From The Wreckage....

826-accept.name: Master Gadrin
826-accept.text:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
826-accept.title: Zalazane

827-progress.name: Margoz
827-progress.text: Have you yet entered Skull Rock, $N?  Do you have the Searing Collars?
827-progress.title: Skull Rock

829-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
829-progress.text: My most humble greetings, $c.  How might I help my $r brother today?
829-progress.title: Neeru Fireblade

830-accept.name: Unknown
830-accept.text:
You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.

This looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
830-accept.title: The Admiral's Orders

830-complete.name: Gar'Thok
830-complete.text: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
830-complete.title: The Admiral's Orders

830-progress.name: Gar'Thok
830-progress.text: There is a look of concern on your face, $c. What have you there?
830-progress.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-accept.name: Gar'Thok
831-accept.text:
Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.

Admiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.

His reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.

We need to get these orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.
831-accept.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-progress.name: Nazgrel
831-progress.text: Can you not see that I am busy? This had better be pressing....
831-progress.title: The Admiral's Orders

832-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-progress.text: You have something vital to report.  I can sense it behind your eyes.
832-progress.title: Burning Shadows

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

837-accept.name: Gar'Thok
837-accept.text:
When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.
837-accept.title: Encroachment

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

901-progress.name: Control Console
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91741-complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741-complete.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91743-accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743-accept.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91745-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91745-accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745-accept.title: Mining Consultant

91745-complete.name: Kelsey Fargo
91745-complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745-complete.title: Mining Consultant

91752-accept.name: Kelsey Fargo
91752-accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752-accept.title: The Big Picture

92124-accept.name: Brother Paxton
92124-accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124-accept.title: Book Inventory

92124-complete.name: Daniel
92124-complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124-complete.title: Book Inventory

92479-accept.name: Marshal McBride
92479-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479-accept.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.
92479-complete.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-progress.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479-progress.title: A Scribbled Letter

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-complete.text:
Well done, lass. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373-complete.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lass, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94374-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94374-complete.text:
Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.

To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still--they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94375-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-complete.text: Well done! Know this--totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-progress.text: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375-progress.title: Call of Earth

94472-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94472-complete.text: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
94472-complete.title: Earth Sapta

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96608-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96608-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96628-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96652-accept.name: Unknown
96652-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652-accept.title: The Adventurer

96652-complete.name: Brakk
96652-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96652-complete.title: The Adventurer

96652-progress.name: Brakk
96652-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96652-progress.title: The Adventurer

96655-accept.name: Brakk
96655-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96655-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96655-complete.name: Cook Torka
96655-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96655-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96655-progress.name: Cook Torka
96655-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96655-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658-complete.name: William Pickman
96658-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96658-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658-progress.name: William Pickman
96658-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96658-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96821-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
96821-accept.text:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821-accept.title: Legging It

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96877-complete.name: Kamari
96877-complete.text: What a trophy, $c! That must have been some fight!
96877-complete.title: Halikor's Hoof

97223-accept.name: Xar'Ti
97223-accept.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223-accept.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97223-complete.name: Xar'Ti
97223-complete.text: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
97223-complete.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97223-progress.name: Xar'Ti
97223-progress.text:
The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
97223-progress.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225-accept.name: Master Vornal
97225-accept.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225-accept.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-complete.name: Kor'geld
97242-complete.text:
This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.

I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242-complete.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with them in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97246-accept.name: Thatog
97246-accept.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246-accept.title: Meal Appeal

97246-complete.name: Borstan
97246-complete.text:
Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246-complete.title: Meal Appeal

97249-accept.name: Borstan
97249-accept.text:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249-accept.title: Favorite Food

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong-flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97275-accept.name: Yelmak
97275-accept.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275-accept.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-complete.name: Whuut
97275-complete.text:
Grorru--whaa?

You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.

Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.

$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275-complete.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-progress.name: Whuut
97275-progress.text: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275-progress.title: Whuut's the Rush

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-complete.name: Grund Drokda
97277-complete.text:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277-complete.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279-accept.name: Gornek
97279-accept.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279-accept.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-complete.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-complete.text: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279-complete.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-progress.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279-progress.title: Wayward Weapons

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97899-accept.name: Brakk
97899-accept.text:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97899-accept.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97899-complete.name: Whuut
97899-complete.text:
There ya have it, directions for your very own Mana Well. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.
97899-complete.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97903-accept.name: Brakk
97903-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97905-accept.name: Brakk
97905-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97905-complete.name: Jandi
97905-complete.text:
Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.
97905-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97907-accept.name: Brakk
97907-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97923-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97923-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97923-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

98319-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-accept.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98319-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-complete.text:
Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.
98319-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-complete.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-complete.text: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
98321-complete.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
98322-accept.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98322-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98322-complete.text:
Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?

I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
98322-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98323-accept.text:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, $N. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-complete.text:
Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.

Well, that's going in the report too.

<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
98323-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lass? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98581-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98581-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the $c trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581-accept.title: Archaic Rune

98581-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-complete.text: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581-complete.title: Archaic Rune

98581-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-progress.text: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.
98581-progress.title: Archaic Rune

99048-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99048-accept.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048-accept.title: A Missing Hand

99123-accept.name: Pal'juh
99123-accept.text:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123-accept.title: Lost in the Shadows

99123-complete.name: Master Vornal
99123-complete.text:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?

Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
99123-complete.title: Lost in the Shadows

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99142-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-accept.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142-accept.title: Tomb Weed

99143-accept.name: Lee Brown
99143-accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143-accept.title: Bottles and Baubles

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains
